metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code skills for banan-tech projects — GitHub-issue authoring and end-to-end issue implementation.

plugins.name: write-issue
plugins.description: Create a well-structured GitHub issue with context, scope, requirements, subtasks, dependencies, testing notes, and a verifiable definition of done.

plugins.name: implement-issue
plugins.description: Pipeline-orchestrate one or more GitHub issues from 'assigned' to 'PR open, ready for review' using isolated worktrees and TDD.
